tagline.en: Robbyant's Apache-2.0 video family — a lightweight 1.3B dense model and a 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts, for text-to-video and image-to-video.
tagline.zh: Robbyant 开源的视频家族——轻量 1.3B dense 模型与 30B-A3B 专家混合模型,支持文生视频与图生视频。

en: LingBot-Video is an open video-generation family from Robbyant, released under Apache-2.0. It generates video from text, from text plus an image, and can also produce still images from text, so it spans several generation modes in one lineup.

The family comes in two flavors: a compact Dense 1.3B for lighter workloads, and a larger MoE 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model that activates a smaller expert subset per step for higher-capacity generation. WorldFoundry ships the inference code with direct Diffusers, optional SGLang, FSDP, context-parallel and CFG-parallel paths, plus an optional refiner stage.
The upstream recommended stack expects a dedicated environment (Transformers 5 / Diffusers 0.39), which WorldFoundry provisions for the route.
zh: LingBot-Video 是 Robbyant 开源的视频生成家族,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它可从文本、从文本加图片生成视频,也能从文本产出静态图像,因而在一条产品线中覆盖多种生成模式。
该家族提供两种形态:紧凑的 Dense 1.3B 适合较轻负载,而更大的 MoE 30B-A3B 专家混合模型每步仅激活一部分专家,以实现更高容量的生成。WorldFoundry 提供的推理代码包含直接 Diffusers、可选 SGLang、FSDP、上下文并行与 CFG 并行等路径,并带一个可选的 refiner 阶段。
上游推荐的运行栈需要专用环境(Transformers 5 / Diffusers 0.39),WorldFoundry 已为该路径准备好。

whenToUse.en: Pick the Dense 1.3B when you want a lighter, openly-licensed video model to prototype text-to-video or image-to-video. Step up to the MoE 30B-A3B when you need higher-capacity generation and have the GPU budget for it.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个较轻、开放许可的视频模型做文生视频或图生视频原型时,选 Dense 1.3B。当你需要更高容量的生成且具备相应 GPU 预算时,升级到 MoE 30B-A3B。

notFor.en: Both Dense and MoE checkpoints are external assets you download separately rather than getting bundled. The MoE model in particular is large and demands substantial GPU memory.
notFor.zh: Dense 与 MoE 的 checkpoint 都是需单独下载的外部资源,而非随附。尤其是 MoE 模型体量庞大,对 GPU 显存要求可观。

en: Two sizes: Dense 1.3B and MoE 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts
Optional SGLang, FSDP, context/CFG-parallel, and refiner paths
zh: 两种规模:Dense 1.3B 与 MoE 30B-A3B 专家混合模型
支持文生视频、文本+图生视频与文生图
可选 SGLang、FSDP、上下文/CFG 并行与 refiner 路径
